app.title: Study Method — Tutor
app.tagline: Learn for real, with AI-generated lessons and hands-on challenges.

settings.keysDescription: Configure the OpenRouter (lesson generation) and Brave Search (source search) keys. Validate each one before using.
settings.localAiDescription: Hardware detection and local models. Download a model, activate it and select "Local model" in the feedback provider to evaluate challenges without relying on the cloud.

sound.label: Sound on confirmations
sound.hint: Off by default. A short sound when tests pass.

motion.label: Reduced motion
motion.hint: Follows the system preference. Information never depends on animation.

settings.clearProgressDescription: Erases all your progress: completed lessons, challenge attempts, proficiency and generated challenges. Track content, settings and keys are kept.
settings.clearProgressConfirmDescription: This permanently erases all your progress in the app (completed lessons, attempts, proficiency and generated challenges). This cannot be undone.
settings.clearProgressConfirmNote: Track content, settings and API keys are not affected.
settings.clearProgressTimeout: The app did not respond in time. Try again.
settings.orphansDescription: Progress kept for tracks that are no longer in resources/tracks. It is hidden from Home so it cannot become a dead link, but it stays here: reinstall the track under the same slug and the progress comes back on its own.
settings.orphansEmpty: Nothing orphaned — every stored progress has an installed track or lessons of its own.
settings.orphansTimeout: The check did not respond in time. Try again.
settings.orphansConfirmTitle: Remove the progress of these courses?
settings.orphansConfirmDescription: This PERMANENTLY erases the progress listed below. It cannot be undone. If you plan to reinstall the track under the same slug, cancel: the progress comes back on its own once it reappears.
settings.orphansCliHint: From the terminal: npm run track -- track:reset-orphans (list) and --yes (remove).

keys.error401: Error 401: invalid key or missing permission.
keys.error402: Error 402: not enough credits on the provider account. Add credits and try again.
keys.error429: Error 429: request limit exceeded. Try again shortly.
keys.errorNetwork: Network error: could not reach the server.
keys.errorTimeout: Timed out while contacting the provider. Check your connection and try again.
keys.saveTimeout: Could not save the key — the app did not respond. Try again.

localAi.title: Local model
localAi.hintActive: This model is active and will be the default grader.
localAi.errorSaveFeedback: Failed to save the feedback provider:

lesson.subjectPlaceholder: What do you want to learn about?
lesson.subjectHelper: Programming and math — e.g. invert a binary tree or solve a quadratic equation.
lesson.sourcesEmpty: This lesson has no external sources.

answer.serviceError: Could not evaluate your answer right now.

math.wrong: Wrong answer. The expected answer was {{expected}}.
math.malformed: I couldn't read your answer as a number. Type just the value (e.g., 7 or 5/6).
math.error: Could not check the answer right now.

lesson.emptyDescription: Pick a track in the Track tab and open a lesson — the content is ready, just study.
lesson.chatStart: This lesson is a chat with the tutor. Click below to start the first theory section.
lesson.quizCorrect: That is what the section shows.
lesson.quizWrong: That option parts ways with what the section shows.
lesson.quizGateNext: This section's quiz is still waiting for the right answer. Picking off target opens, in the conversation, an explanation of where that option parts ways with the section — and a new quiz on the same passage.
lesson.quizGateFinish: The lesson wraps up once every quiz has the right answer ({{n}} still open). Picking off target opens, in the conversation, an explanation of where that option parts ways with the section — and a new quiz on the same passage.
lesson.quizOverlayHint: Answering moves this card into the conversation. The lesson moves on once the right answer shows up.
lesson.quizChatOnScreen: This quiz is open over the screen.
lesson.quizChatExplaining: Writing where the option you picked parts ways with what the section shows…
lesson.quizChatGenerating: Preparing a new quiz on the same passage…
lesson.quizChatUnavailable: The cycle stopped here. You can ask again.
lesson.quizExplanationTitle: Where that option parts ways with what the section shows
lesson.quizExplainUnavailable: The explanation could not be written right now — the AI is offline. The new quiz on the same passage is still on its way.
lesson.quizRemedialUnavailable: The new quiz could not be generated right now — the AI is offline. Nothing you answered was lost.
lesson.quizAttemptNotSaved: This answer did not reach your history on disk; it still counts for this session.
lesson.trackNotFound: Lesson not found in the track.
lesson.trackLoadTimeout: The lesson did not respond in time. Try again.
lesson.nextTimeout: The tutor did not respond when advancing the section. Try again.
lesson.answerTimeout: The tutor took too long to reply. Try again.
lesson.doneTimeout: Could not finish the lesson — the app did not respond. Try again.
lesson.errorQuestion: What do you think went wrong? Type here or speak into the microphone. If you don't know, just say "I don't know".
lesson.regenerateFailed: Could not generate a new challenge.

challenge.keyHint: See the key hint in the statement.
challenge.noChallengesEmpty: No challenges available. Generate a lesson first in the "Lesson" tab.

challenge.piMissingKey: Failed to call the pi: OpenRouter key missing or invalid. Open Settings to register the key.
challenge.announceFailed: Tests failed: {{testsRun}} of {{expectedTests}} cases passed. The failing case is in the output.

split.hint: Drag, or use the arrow keys while the divider has focus

editor.selectFilePrompt: Select a file in the tree on the left to start editing.

home.title: Learn programming and math with AI-generated lessons
home.description: Type a subject — such as "Invert a binary tree" or "Quadratic equations" — and get a lesson with explanation, analogy, visualization and hands-on challenges validated by tests.

configureKeys.title: Set up your AI keys
configureKeys.description: Add and validate your OpenRouter and Brave Search keys in Settings.

subject.title: Type a subject
subject.description: For example: "Invert a binary tree" or "Quadratic equations".

learn.title: Learn and practice with challenges
learn.description: Read the lesson, follow the visualizations and solve test-validated challenges.

setup.readyDescription: Your OpenRouter and Brave Search keys are configured. Pick a subject and start.
setup.missingDescription: Configure the OpenRouter and Brave Search keys so the app can generate lessons and search sources.

switchDialog.title: Subject in progress
switchDialog.description: You can't switch subjects mid-lesson — the current lesson is assessed by the LLM. Finish or end the current lesson before starting another subject.

trail.title: Where you left off
trail.empty: Nothing in progress — pick a subject below

home.tracksDescription: Ready-made courses, from zero to professional. Pick a track and start.
home.tracksTimeout: The tracks did not respond in time. Try again.
home.tracksEmptyDescription: This app does not author tracks on its own: content lives in resources/tracks and is created by the authoring CLI (npm run track -- track:new). Until a track is installed this section stays like this — it is not an error.
home.orphansNotice: Courses from your history that are not installed: {{n}}. Your progress is kept — nothing was deleted.

confirm.skipMessage: Skip the tutorial? You can reopen it later from the help button.
confirm.closeMessage: Close the tutorial? You can reopen it later from the help button.

shellAppTitle.title: Study Method
shellAppTitle.description: This is the coding tutor. Generate AI-powered lessons and solve hands-on challenges in the tabs below.

shellThemeToggle.title: Light/dark theme
shellThemeToggle.description: Switch between light, dark or system theme using the theme button in the top bar.

shellLanguageSwitcher.title: Language
shellLanguageSwitcher.description: Switch the interface language between Portuguese and English here. Your choice is saved automatically.

shellNavTabs.title: Navigation
shellNavTabs.description: Use the tabs to navigate: Settings (configuration), Lesson (lesson generation) and Challenge (practice).

settingsKeys.title: API keys
settingsKeys.description: In Settings you set up and validate the OpenRouter (lesson generation) and Brave Search (sources) keys, and manage the local model.

lessonSubject.title: Generate a lesson
lessonSubject.description: Type the subject you want to learn about and click "Generate lesson" to research sources and build the material.

challengeEditor.title: Code editor
challengeEditor.description: Open a challenge and write your solution in this editor (CodeMirror), without autocomplete — practice coding from memory.

challengeTerminal.title: Test output
challengeTerminal.description: The deterministic test results appear in this terminal, with a pass verdict or failure details.

challengeTestAnswer.title: Test answer
challengeTestAnswer.description: Click "Test answer" to run the tests and get feedback from the grader on your solution.

tourComplete.title: You know the basics!
tourComplete.description: Browse the tabs to explore. You can reopen this tutorial anytime from the help button.

settingsKeysFill.description: Fill in your OpenRouter and Brave Search keys in this section. They power lesson generation and source search.

openSettings.title: Go to Settings
openSettings.description: Click the Settings tab to set up your API keys.

openLesson.title: Go to Lesson
openLesson.description: Click the Lesson tab to generate your first study material.

lessonSubjectFill.description: Type the subject you want to study into this field.

lessonGenerate.title: Generate the lesson
lessonGenerate.description: Click "Generate lesson" to research sources and build the material.

openChallenge.title: Go to Challenge
openChallenge.description: Click the Challenge tab to practice with an exercise.

challengeEditorType.description: Write your solution in this code editor (no autocomplete).

quickStartComplete.title: Done!
quickStartComplete.description: You now know the essentials. You can restart the tutorial anytime from the help button.

qsOpenLesson.description: Navigate to the Lesson tab to generate a study material.

qsOpenChallenge.description: Navigate to the Challenge tab to practice challenges.

qsChallengeTestAnswer.description: When you solve a challenge, click "Test answer" to validate.

selection.title: Want a tour?
selection.subtitle: A short tutorial introduces the interface and shows how to generate lessons and solve challenges.
selection.quickTourDescription: See the top bar, the tabs, and learn to generate a lesson and test a solution.
selection.quickStartDescription: A quick look at the tabs, with no key setup required. Great to get going now.
selection.fullTutorialDescription: Step-by-step guide across all tabs: set up keys, generate a lesson and test a solution.

helpHint.title: Type any doubt
helpHint.description: This is the lesson subject field. Type the topic you want to study and generate an AI-powered lesson.

focus.hint: Hides navigation and leaves only the work

palette.title: Go to
palette.placeholder: Type to search screens, challenges and actions

trilha.title: Study trail
trilha.description: Follow your lesson progress per subject, from beginner to advanced.

empty.noTopics: You don't have subjects with lessons yet. Generate your first lesson in the Lesson tab.
empty.noLessons: This subject has no lessons yet. Generate the first lesson to start the trail.

roadmap.locked: Locked — finish the previous one (or pass the proficiency test)
roadmap.loadTimeout: The track did not respond in time. Try again.
roadmap.noTracks: No tracks installed yet. Tracks are created by the tool authors (CLI).
roadmap.proficiencyDescription: One challenge covering ALL modules of the track. Pass it to unlock the whole course and start wherever you want.
roadmap.sequentialHint: Lessons unlock in order: finish one to release the next — or pass the proficiency test to unlock everything.
roadmap.listFailed: Could not load the track list.
roadmap.noTracksHint: Create the first one with the authoring CLI: npm run track -- track:new <slug> --title "…" --description "…"

challengeGen.title: Generating new challenge
challengeGen.stageValidating: Checking coherence with what you learned
challengeGen.stageInserting: Adding to the top of the challenges
challengeGen.doneHint: The new challenge is at the top of the list.
